# archestra_remote_agent (Resource)

External A2A agent registration and its saved connection. Registration does not execute an outbound agent run. Source uses the current JSON Schema Agent Card format; protobuf JSON cards must be converted before declaration. Credential values are write-only and preserved on metadata changes; imports require explicit replacement authentication before changing an authenticated discovery source. Destroy removes the registration and assignments, preserving external agent servers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "archestra_remote_agent" "external" {
  name    = "external-agent"
  enabled = false
  source = jsonencode({
    type = "inline_card"
    agentCard = {
      name        = "External agent"
      description = "Existing external A2A service."
      version     = "1.0.0"
      supportedInterfaces = [{
        url             = "https://a2a.example.invalid/agent"
        protocolBinding = "JSONRPC"
        protocolVersion = "1.0"
      }]
      capabilities         = { streaming = false }
      defaultInputModes    = ["text/plain"]
      defaultOutputModes   = ["text/plain"]
      skills               = []
      securitySchemes      = {}
      securityRequirements = []
    }
  })
  auth = jsonencode({ type = "none" })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source` (String) JSON source object using well_known or card_url with url, or inline_card with a canonical JSON Schema agentCard.

### Optional

- `auth` (String, Sensitive) Sensitive JSON authentication object: none, bearer with credential, or api_key with headerName and credential; omit to preserve authentication and set type none to clear it.
- `description` (String) Description, defaulting to the Agent Card description; an empty string clears it.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the saved remote connection can be used; omission preserves its current setting.
- `initial_grants` (Attributes Set) Direct grants applied atomically when the object is created; changes require replacement, and later permission changes belong to archestra_resource_permission_policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--initial_grants))
- `name` (String) Registration name, defaulting to the Agent Card name on creation.

### Read-Only

- `agent_card` (String) Normalized saved Agent Card as JSON.
- `assignment_count` (Number) Number of agents assigned to this connection.
- `author_id` (String) Author id.
- `author_name` (String) Author name.
- `card_hash` (String) Card hash.
- `connection_id` (String) Connection UUID used by archestra_agent_remote_delegations.
- `connection_metadata` (String) Connection metadata as JSON, with credential material omitted by the API.
- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `created_by` (String) Creator metadata as JSON.
- `created_by_service_account_id` (String) Created by service account id.
- `discovery_mode` (String) Saved discovery mode.
- `discovery_url` (String) Saved discovery URL, absent for inline cards.
- `id` (String) Remote registration UUID.
- `last_discovered_at` (String) Last discovered at.
- `last_used_at` (String) Last used at.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization id.
- `tool_id` (String) Tool id.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.

<a id="nestedatt--initial_grants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `initial_grants`

Required:

- `actions` (Set of String) Actions granted to the principal.
- `subject_id` (String) Principal ID; use * for the organization principal.
- `subject_type` (String) Principal type.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_remote_agent.external "REMOTE_AGENT_ID"
```
